Paths with blanks (e.g. macOS "Application Support", Windows "Program Files") are valid environments, so this is a documented result contradicted on a valid input, not a limitation.
why: Environment-variable branch is well tested with self-set variables. The PYTHON comparison oracle (sys.path read independently, newline-joined) is good, but the test asserts that no sys.path entry contains a blank, comma or quote, so it hides the documented-result failure that it records as a limitation. Line 39 strips every blank from every system entry (and lines 32-40 split on commas inside entries); the header (lines 9-11, 17-19) documents NAME='PYTHON' as comparing the MATLAB and system python paths and returning common entries.
suggestion: Quarantine comparePaths; a fix would print sys.path one entry per line (as the test does) instead of parsing the repr.
